tools.name: meku_search_humans
tools.description: Search saved-profile aggregate counts for public and listed MEKU humans marked online, requiring every requested skill on the same human. Only the first 500 saved profiles are checked; counts_complete=false means partial counts, not a complete total. Countries list only profiles matching the request

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "meku_search_humans" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
